versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11022 If the parameters in a call of TerminateApplication are valid and the above cri- teria are met TerminateApplication shall terminate <Application> (i.e. to kill all Task s, disable the interrupt sources of those ISR s which belong to the OS-Application and free all other OS resources associated with the application). The <Application> state is set to APPLICATION_TERMINATED . If the caller belongs to <Application> TerminateApplication shall not return, otherwise it shall return E_OK .

If the parameters in a call of TerminateApplication are valid and the above criteria are met TerminateApplication shall terminate <Applica- tion> (i.e. to kill all Task s, disable the interrupt sources of those ISR s which belong to the OS-Application and free all other OS resources associated with the applica- tion) AND shall activate the configured OsRestartTask of <Application> if <Restart Option> equals RESTART . If no OsRestartTask is configured, no restart shall hap- pen. If the <Application> is restarted, its state is set to APPLICATION_RESTARTING otherwise to APPLICATION_TERMINATED . If the caller belongs to <Application> Ter- minateApplication shall not return, otherwise it shall return E_OK .
